description: Skip-turn recovery: +0.5 energy (+1.5 with an intact shelter in the region), once per tick. NOTE: without a shelter, rest recovers less than passive decay (1/tick base); you cannot idle to survive. Keep foraging, or maintain a shelter (its wood upkeep is the price of resting ahead of decay).
